item.title: Foxconn sees AI rack shipments grow multiple-fold in 2026 after 2Q operating profit rises 68%
item.summary: Foxconn's AI server business powered stronger-than-expected second-quarter 2026 revenue and profit, with growth in its cloud network products segment helping operating profit rise far faster than sales. At its August 12 earnings conference, the company said stronger product mix and scale benefits lifted profitability, while continued AI infrastructure demand should sustain shipment growth through the second half.
